subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should OpenClaw land this doctor migration change after rebase/CI, accepting the upgrade-sensitive preservation of SecretRef and OAuth fields into the per-agent SQLite auth store?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well proven, but automation cannot decide the shipped legacy-shape blast radius or the intended credential privacy boundary for migrated OAuth and SecretRef material.

options.title: Land after auth owner review
options.body: Accept the upgrade-sensitive migration behavior because the PR preserves existing credential fields through the doctor-owned migration path and has focused before/after proof.

options.title: Add broader shipped-shape coverage first
options.body: Ask for one more regression around an observed shipped auth-profile shape before merge if maintainers want lower residual upgrade risk.

options.title: Coordinate with adjacent flat-store work
options.body: Pause only if maintainers want this field-preservation fix landed together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98245 because both touch the same doctor auth file.

recommendation.title: Land after auth owner review
recommendation.body: Accept the upgrade-sensitive migration behavior because the PR preserves existing credential fields through the doctor-owned migration path and has focused before/after proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete carried the SQLite auth-profile migration and related SecretRef repair history that defines the upgrade boundary being changed here.
